basisStatement: Resume always reuses the governed upload session and storage_ref. Recovery is lawful only through the frozen tenant, client, request, and request-version scope established at allocation time. Byte transfer, checksum, scan, validation, attachment confirmation, and current-request satisfaction remain separate states. Transfer success never becomes customer-visible completion by implication. The atlas renders 7 deterministic recovery cases without exposing payload bytes or provider URLs.

stages.label: ALLOCATED
stages.summary: Frozen request identity, resumable session, and one governed storage lineage.

stages.label: UPLOADING
stages.summary: Chunk windows advance only at the contiguous resume offset or as duplicate-safe replays.

stages.label: CHECKSUM
stages.summary: Chunk digests verify independently before the transfer closes over the manifest checksum.

stages.label: SCANNING
stages.summary: Transfer success can settle while malware or checksum delay still blocks attachment meaning.

stages.label: VALIDATION
stages.summary: Validation decides whether bytes are acceptable evidence, replacement-only, or rejected.

stages.label: ATTACHMENT
stages.summary: Attachment and current-request satisfaction remain explicit and never piggyback on transfer success.

subtitle: Governed byte transfer, checksum, rebase, and attachment posture for reconnect-safe upload sessions.
